Round 1's code head b1f5946c was fully green (lint, typecheck, test, build, dispatch, dispatch-memory, dispatch-multiprocess, dispatch-browser-multiprocess, envoy-go, envoy-go-race, envoy-e2e-local, envoy-infra-go, envoy-session-stall, envoy-smoke, pr-title). findings: Unchanged from round 1 and not this change's: Go's Parse reads a CommonMark HTML declaration ('<!' then a letter) as plain text where the browser engine reads inline raw HTML, so 'p <!a> q' is stored 'p \<!a> q' and shown as that text in a document while a comment hides the declaration. The architect put it into dispatch://INFRA-752's spec on 2026-10-29, which owns the inline-raw-HTML misreads.
